evals.prompt: Review the finished agent session in session.jsonl (a Claude Code transcript) as a dry run. The skills it used are under skills/ and were authored by this project's user. List the skills the session used, find what went wrong or slowly and why, and propose concrete improvements to those skills. Write report.md in your output directory. Do not modify anything under skills/. Do not read evals.json or any other variant.
evals.expected_output: Lists release-notes as the only used skill; traces the two failed publish calls and the user correction to the stale --channel flag in SKILL.md step 4 and proposes --track with a minimal hunk and version bump; notes the duplicate style.md read; applies nothing.

assertions.text: The proposal replaces the stale flag with --track.
The proposal ties the failure to the responsible SKILL.md step or line and gives a minimal hunk that bumps metadata.version.
No file under skills/ changed and the report says nothing was applied.
Evidence is described, not pasted as transcript excerpts or tool output blocks.
